description: Run the model's state machines over time (timers, change triggers, scenario events) and judge the requirements and constraints over the run. Output: machines, the trace of fired transitions, and verdicts over time.

events.description: Scenario events: at time t, fire the transition or deliver the signal called name.

root.description: The top level part usage to elaborate (default: the last one, the configured system).

stop_s.description: Simulated seconds to run (default: until no timer is pending).

text.description: The complete SysML v2 model text. The server keeps no state: pass the whole current text on every call, and after an edit use the text the edit returned.

name: simulate
title: Run the state machines
